QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE` is a name-mangling macro... `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member` ... "`library/common.h:132` defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` unconditionally, so every library `.c` ... sees plain field names" and "External applications: Plain `->field` is a compile error."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows both macro branches and states that code defining the opt-out sees plain names while ordinary external consumers see the mangled `private_` names.
